name: CNPJ.ws public API (publica.cnpj.ws)
operator: CNPJ.ws (Brazilian company running the public and commercial CNPJ APIs)
tier_rationale: Identifiable Brazilian operator with a documented public API, a commercial tier, published terms and a multi-year public track record (A8 community). 'Tiers: BrasilAPI, Minha Receita, CNPJ.ws and Querido Diario (Open Knowledge Brasil) community.' (P236 cond 1).

reliability.justification: Relays the RFB CNPJ dump with its own refresh date (atualizado_em); keeps partners of earlier dumps, so only the latest refresh month is the current QSA (prep H10).

public.title: CNPJ.ws public API /cnpj/{cnpj} (state registrations IE, IBGE ids, QSA)

terms.quote: Sources at release (class open, legal_dpo): BrasilAPI and Minha Receita (MIT code, RFB open data; one shared parser), publica.cnpj.ws public API (only free source of state IE) and Querido Diario company/partners.

public.notes: Quote: binding council text (P236 cond 1). Research C0520 terms 'cnpj.ws public tier terms; commercial tier needs token' (the token is never used here). Endpoint https://publica.cnpj.ws/cnpj/{cnpj}: 404 {status: 404, titulo: 'Nao encontrado'} for an unknown or alphanumeric CNPJ, 400 for a wrong check digit. Observed headers x-ratelimit-limit 3, x-ratelimit-remaining, x-ratelimit-reset 60 (research C0520, prep 2026-11-26): 3 requests per minute, so the quota block is a token bucket (burst 3) and cnpj_lookup calls it only as the last resort of the chain, skipping it - never sleeping more than 2 s - when its bucket or the x-ratelimit-remaining/reset headers say it is empty (P236 cond 3). Sets a Cloudflare bot-management cookie (never stored); a challenge page is BLOCKED, never retried. Used by cnpj_lookup.

notes: Owned by batch p1-G10-2 (P236). Single-batch host (owners.json maps publica.cnpj.ws to no provider). min_interval stays 1 s on purpose: the 3/min budget is a token bucket the module checks before calling, so the chain skips an empty bucket instead of waiting (P236 cond 3). ttl 259200 = CNPJ class.
